description: Put a host or service that was taken out of the monitoring back in. A host brings its services back with it. It is checked again from the next configuration export.

hostname.description: Exact host name. Required - there is no estate-wide form of this tool. A name that matches no host is answered with the tools that can find the right one.

servicename.description: Exact service name on that host. Empty: the host and its services.

name: resume_monitoring
title: Resume Monitoring
